title: Slow-roast lamb shoulder, mash and green beans
summary: A long, quiet roast. The potatoes and beans get prepped during it, so the last 45 minutes stay calm.

steps.title: Get everything out
steps.line: Lamb, veg and stock by the board. Measure the stock.
steps.done: Everything within reach.

steps.title: Oven on, tray on its sheet
steps.line: It heats while you prep. Always lift the foil tray by the sheet.
steps.done: Oven light off: it is hot.

steps.title: Onion into 8 thick wedges
steps.line: Chunky, not sliced. They hold the lamb up.
steps.done: 8 wedges.

steps.title: Garlic and rosemary
steps.line: Crush 3 cloves, keep 3 whole. Chop 2 sprigs, keep 1 whole.
steps.done: Two piles: for the rub, for the tray.

steps.title: Rub the lamb
steps.line: Oil, crushed garlic, rosemary, salt, pepper. All over. No searing.
steps.done: Coated all over. Wash your hands.

steps.title: Build the tray
steps.line: Onions, garlic and sprig in. Lamb on top, fat up. Stock around it, not over.
steps.done: Lamb sits on the onions, above the stock.

steps.title: Seal with two layers of foil
steps.line: Crimp hard round the rim, twice.
steps.done: Press round the rim. No gaps.

steps.title: Roast covered
steps.line: Middle shelf, on its sheet. Leave it alone.
steps.done: Timer ends. Check tenderness.
full: Check early only if you smell burning or see a leak.
Oven hotter, or eating sooner? At 160°C fan, check at about 3 h.

steps.title: Get ahead: potatoes and beans
steps.line: Peel and chunk the potatoes into cold water, off the heat. Trim the beans.

hold.how: in cold water, off the heat

steps.done: Potatoes under cold water. Beans trimmed, back in the fridge.
full: 600 g is about 2–3 large potatoes, not a whole bag.
Weigh 40 g butter for the mash and 10 g for the beans. Measure 125 ml milk.

steps.title: Tenderness check
steps.line: Peel back one foil corner, away from your face. Twist a fork in the thickest part.

check.cue: The fork turns easily and the meat pulls apart.

steps.done: Fork turns easily.
full: Still firm? Reseal the corner and give it 30 more minutes, then check again.

steps.title: Foil off, oven up
steps.line: Keep the foil for resting. Spoon some juice over. Back in, uncovered.
steps.done: Lamb back in, uncovered.

steps.title: Brown the lamb
steps.line: Until deep golden. Splash of water if the tray runs dry.
steps.done: Deep golden all over.

steps.title: Potatoes on to boil
steps.line: Only after the lamb passed its check. Water 2 cm over the top, salted.
steps.done: Rolling boil across the whole pan.

steps.title: Simmer the potatoes
steps.line: Steady simmer until a knife slides in.

check.cue: A knife slides in with no resistance.

steps.done: Knife slides in.

steps.title: Lamb out to rest
steps.line: Onto a platter under the saved foil. Onions to a dish. Juices stay in the tray. Oven off.
steps.done: Lamb resting, loosely covered.
full: Put the plates in the switched-off oven to warm.

steps.title: Lamb rests
steps.line: Mash, sauce and beans happen now.
steps.done: 20 minutes have passed.

steps.title: Drain. Warm the milk in the same pan.
steps.line: Potatoes steam-dry 2 min in the colander. Milk warms in the empty pan.
steps.done: Dry potatoes, steaming milk in a mug.

steps.title: Mash
steps.line: Butter first, then warm milk a splash at a time. Season. Lid on.
steps.done: Smooth. Seasoned. Lid on.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.line: Kettle on. Zest the lemon first. Juices through a sieve, skim the fat, heat and taste.
steps.done: Tastes good to you. Lowest heat.
full: Do not lift the hot foil tray to pour. Spoon or ladle the juices into the sieve.
Watery: simmer it. Too salty: a little water. Flat: a squeeze of lemon.

steps.title: Cook the green beans
steps.line: Into the boiled kettle water. Drain. Butter, lemon zest, a squeeze.
steps.done: Bright green, with a little bite.

steps.title: Serve
steps.line: Pull the lamb into chunks with two forks. Plate with mash, beans and onions. Sauce over.
steps.done: Eat. Leftovers in the fridge within 2 hours.

sources.name: Recipe written in a ChatGPT conversation
sources.use: the dish and method. Re-planned here: order, timing and the missing steps

changes.what: Added a step to warm the milk
changes.why: The recipe asked for warm milk but never warmed it. It warms in the drained potato pan. No extra pan.

changes.what: Potatoes and beans prepped during the roast
changes.why: They wait in cold water, off the heat. The pan only goes on after the lamb passes its check. This removes about 15 minutes of rush at the end.

changes.what: Check tenderness through one foil corner
changes.why: Resealing one corner is quick and keeps the seal tight.

changes.what: Keep the browning foil for the resting lamb
Do not lift the hot foil tray to pour
changes.why: A full, hot foil tray bends and spills. Ladle the juices instead.

changes.what: Zest the lemon before you cut it
changes.why: You cannot zest a cut lemon easily.

changes.what: Kettle on when the sauce starts
changes.why: The bean water is ready fast, so the beans cook last and go out hot.

changes.what: Amounts at the first step that touches the food
changes.why: The potato amount used to appear only at the boil step.

changes.what: Suggested salt for the potato water
changes.why: The recipe said 'add salt' with no amount. About 1 tsp is a suggestion.
